opening: I have this excruciating pain in my chest.
It started last night, along with the pain.
I was driving my car and was trying to answer my cell phone. When I looked up, I found that I had veered off the road. I immediately tried to slow down but hit a tree.
It's some of the worst pain I've ever had. At least 8 out of 10.
I have a few scratches on my arms from the car accident.
I have pain in my belly.

opening.text: I'm having trouble breathing and I have this excruciating pain in my chest. It started last night, along with the pain. It's some of the worst pain I've ever had, at least 8 out of 10. I have pain in my belly and a few scratches on my arms from a car accident I was in. I was driving my car and was trying to answer my cell phone. When I looked up, I found that I had veered off the road. I immediately tried to slow down but hit a tree.
